summary: calkyippie executes hidden XOR-encoded shell payload on require
details: On require('calkyippie'), main.js reads a hex `signature` field from the package's own package.json, XOR-decodes it with the hardcoded key 'theskyisbeautiful', and when the plaintext begins with 'EXEC_MODE' passes the trailing command to child_process.exec after a 1-second delay. The decoded payload begins 'EXEC_MODE=1; curl -...', fetching and running attacker-controlled shell on the host. The README presents the package as a calculator utility and a bundled DISCLOSURE file preemptively frames the hex blob as proprietary 'IP protection', neither of which matches the actual decoded behavior. The hex field is not a cryptographic signature; it is an obfuscated command payload decoded and executed at module load time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
